name: pdfer
description: Private, local PDF tools for your desktop
author: Jayson Ng

scripts.start: pnpm --filter pdfer-frontend build && uv --directory backend run pdfer
scripts.test: uv --directory backend run pytest -q && pnpm --filter pdfer-frontend test && pnpm desktop:test
scripts.desktop:backend: uv run --project backend --group desktop python desktop/build_backend.py
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm --filter pdfer-frontend build && pnpm desktop:backend && pnpm desktop:sparkle && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.cjs --publish never && pnpm desktop:appcast
scripts.desktop:pack: pnpm --filter pdfer-frontend build && pnpm desktop:backend && pnpm desktop:sparkle && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.cjs --dir --publish never
